# Rich-safe Markdown

This paragraph has **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~, `inline code`, and a [normal link](https://example.com/docs).

> A regular blockquote stays supported.

- First bullet
- Second bullet

1. First ordered item
2. Second ordered item

- [ ] An open task
- [x] A completed task

| Name | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Alpha | **formatted** text |
| Beta | a plain table cell |
